title: Lock your main character first by creating a single portrait reference node…
content:
Lock your main character first by creating a single portrait reference node, refine it once, and reuse it as the single source of truth across all Seedance 2.0 shots to prevent character drift.

Feed your script to TapNow’s Agent to auto-split it into shots and generate a 4×4 storyboard, then refine each panel before generating any video so every cut is planned.

Use Seedance 2.0 with dual input (storyboard + character reference) to keep continuity while generating the final video.

Set the look in Cinema Lab before Seedance 2.0 generation by choosing a multi-angle + lens combo (e.g., handheld feel + 35mm grain) to guide the visual style.
